name: StatusPal Next
free_limit: Free forever: 2 team members, 5 monitoring checks, 1 public status page, 500 subscribers, and 1 monitoring region.
watch_out: StatusPal Next is distinct from the legacy StatusPal pricing plans. Free tier has no custom domain, private status page, incident automation, or SMS notifications. Credit-card requirements, commercial-use terms, and overage behavior need provider confirmation.
